preamble: The retroflex fricative [ʂ] is often pronounced as the alveolar fricative [s] in Southern Mandarin and Taiwanese Mandarin phonology.

examples.note: Widespread merger of retroflex fricatives into alveolar counterparts.
Retroflex ṣ merges with s, and the cluster assimilates
Northern Vietnamese merged retroflex s with x [s]
